title: Visual assets for a pixel game
author: Simpl3N00b
selftext:
Hi guys, recently I started working on my top down 8 directional pixel game in Godot.

Regarding my workflow for AI assisted coding - I'm building incrementally, test the feature in a playtest, fix if necessary, repeat. So far it's pretty good and the movement and combat feel surprisingly great.

I'm approaching a stage, where I would want to build a short demo in a dungeon with graphics, but this has been a total nightmare.  
I've generated some concept arts in ChatGPT - asked him to recreate them in Blender, but it turned out as total shit.

Please, what's your workflow for creating visual assets (characters, items, maps, ...) ? What model, tools, etc are you using?

comments.author: Thomas_Martin74
comments.body: are u trying to generate finished sprites directly or use AI concept art as reference? Those seem like two very difference workflows

replies.author: Simpl3N00b
replies.body:
I build concept arts first :) then take them, specify each "attribute" of the model, tweak every detail. Then I make outputs from several directions and import them to blender.

I've used Codex and Sol 6.1 to work in Blender. But the result was just bad.. :D Nothing close to what I've wanted
